The colum names are:
"AREA""PERIMETER""GRID2_ID""MAJOR_LC""WOLVES_01""RD_DENSITY""WOLVES_99""PRED_SUIT"
I want to fill the shapefile by WOLVES_99 but I have not access
to my column names after using 'fortify'

myshp <-readShapeSpatial("Pshape.shp")
names(myshp)
shp <- fortify(myshp)
shp <- shp[order(shp$order), ]
ggplot(data=shp, aes(long, lat, group=group,fill=WOLVES_99)) +
geom_polygon()

# I am getting this error because the variable is gone after fortify
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'WOLVES_99' not found

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: fortify question
parts:
Fortify just extracts the coordinates. Use as.data.frame to extra the
other variables and then merge with the output of fortify.

Hadley
